spanish: los vestidos del tejido para ministrar en lo santo, los vestidos de la santidad a Aarón el sacerdote, y los vestidos de sus hijos para sacerdotear.
grammarChanges: Replaced "del servicio" with "del tejido" at h02035019003: הַשְּׂרָד is a separate noun for plaited/stitched work; "servicio" added a service concept not in that lemma.
Replaced "en el santo" with "en lo santo" at h02035019005: same licensed sense (holiness/holy place) for בַּקֹּדֶשׁ, but the neuter form avoids the masculine "el santo" being read as a holy person.
readerNote: Chose neuter "lo santo" over masculine "el santo" for בַּקֹּדֶשׁ to avoid a holy-person misreading while keeping the same holiness/holy-place sense.
